name: DarkPad
notes: DarkPad owns its release recipe (darkpad-v...-padmint.json). Apple Silicon Mac builds a personal unsigned iPhone/iPad IPA; the player imports a Perfect Dark USA Rev 1 / v1.1 ROM in the app.

steps: Open DarkPad and choose your own Perfect Dark (USA) Rev 1 / v1.1 ROM from Files. Accepted formats: .z64, .v64 and .n64. The ROM is imported in the app, not used during the build.

Create or select an agent file, then choose Solo Missions to start. Use the ••• menu for display, touch controls and controller settings. Optional artwork and GoldenEye content are separate and are not included.
For updates, install over the existing app with the same signing setup to keep saves and settings. Deleting DarkPad deletes its local data.

off_mac.text: DarkPad has an experimental build on GitHub's Mac for iPhone/iPad. This route currently requires a private copy of PadMint: follow the guide to import it, then run the build there. Private GitHub builds use your account's Actions allowance. After installing, add your own Perfect Dark ROM inside DarkPad. A clean hosted build passed; installing and playing it still need testing.

es.text: DarkPad tiene una compilación experimental en el Mac de GitHub para iPhone/iPad. Por ahora esta ruta requiere una copia privada de PadMint: sigue la guía para importarla y ejecuta la compilación allí. Las compilaciones privadas de GitHub consumen la cuota de Actions de tu cuenta. Después de instalarla, añade tu propia ROM de Perfect Dark dentro de DarkPad. Una compilación limpia en GitHub terminó correctamente; instalarla y jugarla aún necesitan pruebas.
